method: seeded random sample (seed 0) of DELETED ledger rows; for each: the payload must be absent, its DERIVED_DELETED.json resolver must exist and name it, the resolver sha256 must equal the ledger's on_disk_sha256, and the recorded rebuild source must still be a file on disk
note: run mid-sweep; the population grows as the sweep proceeds, so this is a sample audit of the mechanism, not a census of every deletion
